text:
Anna: Quick design review — I'm putting up a compact drilldown skeleton for the Error Explorer. trying to reduce vertical noise on request rows.
Mike: Nice. Can you paste the current wireframe? curious about where the correlation id sits.
Anna: pasted a gif in the doc but gist: left: compact request line, middle: small stacktrace preview, right: actions (copy id / download / reopen). correlation id is inline but truncated.
Raj: Question: when truncated, should the correlation id expand on hover or be a modal? hover tooltip might be fragile for keyboard users.
Tina: accessibility +1 to expanding inline with a button to "Show full id". hover-only is not acceptable. also needs aria-live on the copy confirmation.
Luis: For screen readers, prefer a visible label: "Correlation ID, truncated" with a button "Reveal full ID" that toggles aria-expanded. button should be in tab order.
Mike: UX copy suggestion: change "Download" to "Download snapshot (JSON)" to reduce confusion with other exports.
Anna: agree. Also thinking of a micro copy under stacktrace preview: "Top frame only — click to expand full trace". short, helps discoverability.
Raj: Implementation note: the download endpoint currently streams a .ndjson. backend can add a header to hint type. frontend can append .json filename. pinging @deploy-bot to confirm.
deploy-bot: build #frontend/3842 passed — api: add-download-filename header deployed to staging.
Mike: Cool. Also debate: Should export include request headers? security/privacy concerns for PII in headers.
Tina: default should redact sensitive headers, with an enterprise toggle to include raw headers for private deployments.
Anna: design: show a subtle shield icon and tooltip when headers are redacted: "Raw headers hidden — enterprise setting required." 
Luis: a11y nit: ensure the shield icon has meaningful alt text / aria-label and is keyboard-focusable.
Raj: engineering: bulk of the compact layout will save ~20% vertical density. but watch out for performance when expanding many traces at once.
Mike: Prioritization: copy + a11y fixes (aria labels, reveal button) first, then filename + redact policy, then compact performance tweaks. 
Anna: I'll update the mock and the copy table. Assigning tasks: @Tina handle a11y copy and focus flow, @Raj to spike expansion perf, @Mike to finalize copy for release notes.
Tina: on it. I'll drop a checklist and the aria pattern in the doc.
Raj: I'll run a perf diff on staging with 1000 concurrent trace items.
Mike: Thanks folks. We'll review again Friday 14:00. :thumbsup:
Anna: added follow-up comments in Figma and the product doc. Thanks!
